---
title: "Columns and callouts"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div.columns > div.column', 'div.callout-note', 'div.callout-tip']
        - ['div.callout > div.callout-body', 'div.callout-note.callout-style-default']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['div.callout-note p.callout-title']
          matches: ['Sample size']
        # an untitled callout is titled with its type, as in other formats
        - selectors: ['div.callout-tip p.callout-title']
          matches: ['Tip']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # a percentage width becomes the bare number emil.js expects (A13)
        - ['::: \{\.column width="60"\}', '::: \{\.column width="40"\}', 'Sample size \{\.callout-title\}', '::: \{\.callout-tip\}']
        - ['width="60%"', '::: \{\}', '\{\.callout-note\}\n>']
---

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
- Chinstrap
- Gentoo
:::
::: {.column width="40%"}
::: {.callout-note}
## Sample size
n = 344
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Be brief.
:::
:::
::::
